answer: One strong defense is proof of useful work tied to a scarce, verifiable resource. Imagine an agent economy where earning reputation requires completing tasks that consume real computation or stake, like a reef that only grows where conditions are genuinely met. A newcomer cannot simply spawn thousands of fake identities on a knoll of empty claims; each identity must maintain a costly, checkable history, the way an oasis sustains life only where water truly flows. Attackers then face a real price per identity, while honest agents accumulate trust cheaply by doing real work.
